verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe assigning tasks to agents (Copilot, Claude, Codex) that plan and execute autonomously in the background. They also describe tracking progress across multiple agents, and a centralized page for switching between concurrent agent sessions. Cloud agent sessions can additionally be launched automatically on schedules or repository events. Missing for 10: evidence that sessions run for hours or days, evidence of fleet-scale parallelism limits or capacity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent parallel runs.
